items.raw_excerpt: The fall season is upon us, and that means it's time for pumpkin patches, wagon rides, cozy small towns, and warm cups of spiced coffee. If you're looking for a charming spot to soak up the autumn season in Ontario, you may want to add this little waterfront town to your plans.
items.summary_en: Thornbury on Georgian Bay is a charming small town with cozy cafes and apple markets. The town offers pumpkin patches, wagon rides, and warm spiced coffee for autumn visitors. It's a perfect spot to enjoy the fall season in Ontario.

items.raw_excerpt: Colo Colo dominó de principio a fin a Huachipato en el "Ester Roa Rebolledo", pero fue incapaz de romper el cero ante su rival en la fecha 22 de la Liga de Primera. Con esto, el equipo de Jaime García dio por cerrada una seguidilla de cuatro derrotas consecutivas en la Liga de Primera.
items.summary_en: Huachipato drew 0-0 with Colo Colo at the Ester Roa Rebolledo stadium in Concepción. The home team played well but could not score despite dominating for much of the match. The draw ended Huachipato's four-game losing streak in the Chilean league.

items.raw_excerpt: Tamil British author Gayathiri Kamalakanthan and Nigerian American artist Chi Nwosu have joined forces to create Bad Queer, an intricately illustrated verse novel about a queer person coming of age.
items.summary_en: Tamil British author Gayathiri Kamalakanthan and Nigerian American artist Chi Nwosu have created Bad Queer, an illustrated verse novel about a queer person coming of age. The author's experience working as a sex educator in schools partly inspired the book.
